title: Divine Mercy Parish Carrom Tournament 2026
description: Official Parish Carrom Championship 2026. 3 Groups with 18 players competing across 5 boards, followed by Quarterfinals, Semifinals and Grand Final.

rules.title: Match Duration
rules.content: Each game is 7 minutes of active play. Standard carrom scoring applies.

rules.title: Playoff Qualification
rules.content: Top 2 from each group + 2 Best 3rd place finishers advance to Quarterfinals (8 players total).

rules.title: Fellowship & Fair Play
rules.content: Opening prayer at 08:00 AM. Mutual respect for opponents and table marshals.

title: Divine Mercy Parish Chess Tournament 2026
description: Official Parish Chess Championship 2026. 6 players in a 15-match round-robin stage followed by the Championship Final between Top 2.

rules.title: Game Time
rules.content: 10 minutes rapid play per game with quick board reset.

rules.title: Final Match
rules.content: Top 2 players from the round-robin standings contest the Championship Final.

rules.title: Fair Play
rules.content: Respectful silence during play and shake hands before/after every match.

title: Divine Mercy Parish Table Tennis Tournament 2026
description: Official Parish Table Tennis Championship 2026. 9 players across Group A (4 players) & Group B (5 players), leading to crossover semifinals and grand final.

rules.title: Match Format
rules.content: 5 minutes match duration on Table 1. Best of sets rule applies.

rules.title: Semifinals & Final
rules.content: Group A Rank 1 vs Group B Rank 2, and Group B Rank 1 vs Group A Rank 2. Winners advance to Grand Final.

rules.title: Fellowship
rules.content: Good sportsmanship, cheer for all parish players.

title: Divine Mercy Parish Cricket Tournament 2026
description: Official Parish Cricket Championship 2026. 5 teams: Divine United, Yellow Palthans, Game Changers, Pink Panthers, and Green Goblin. Top 2 contest the Grand Final.

rules.title: Match Format
rules.content: Rapid 5 overs per side. Rotational bowling with standard cricket rules.

rules.title: Championship Final
rules.content: Top 2 teams on the league points table contest the Grand Final at 05:00 PM.

rules.title: Sportsmanship
rules.content: Umpire decisions are final. Respect opponents and celebrate parish fellowship.

title: Divine Mercy Parish Throwball Tournament 2026
description: Official Parish Throwball Championship 2026. 5 teams: Divine United, Yellow Palthans, Game Changers, Pink Panthers, and Green Goblin. Top 2 contest the Grand Final.

rules.title: Match Format
rules.content: Best of 3 sets format. Standard rotational catching and throwing rules apply.

rules.title: Championship Final
rules.content: Top 2 teams on the league points table advance to the Grand Final at 05:00 PM.

rules.title: Fellowship
rules.content: Fair play, support teammates, and cheer for all participating parish teams.
